body:
Source: GitHub beamfall/corvint#800.

Observed: `docs corpus discover-playwright` refuses a complete unfiltered listing of a config with one grepInvert and two grep projects: `playwright listing omits project ... which the config selects in the current sources`. Cause: PlaywrightListedTests calls observePlaywrightListMembership with nil cases, so classifyPlaywrightGrepOmission never runs, while PlaywrightDiscoveryFromList passes them.

Expected: both entry points apply the same TJAA-V0-021 omission rules to the same listing.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#801 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801; landed by batch PR #801); on main at 8f032d969f26dc0d3bd10ec0248566070161272d (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801). Tests named in the PR: TJAA-V0-021 PlaywrightListedTests grep omission and case/execution tests. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: docs corpus discover-playwright refuses grep-split listings: listed tests skip TJAA-V0-021 omission rules (GH #800)
